abilities.name: %Spell
abilities.description: Used in items to make a "spell effect" occur on a percent chance on each hit or crit. The spell cast is specified by the NEXT "CastsSp" attribute. See "CastsSp".

abilities.name: AC
abilities.description: Modifies the AC value specified by the parameter, this AC is NOT affected by the targets weight. Used in barkskin and stoneskin.

abilities.name: AC(Blur)
abilities.description: Modifies the AC value specified by the parameter, this AC IS affected by the targets encumberance. Used in blur, and the spell for the amethyst pendant.

abilities.name: Accuracy
abilities.description: Increases the targets accuracy by the value specified in the parameter. (bless increases this value by 3, divine favour increases it by 10)

abilities.name: Accuracy (3)
abilities.description: Increases or decreases accuracy by the value specified in the parameter.

abilities.name: Accuracy(2)
abilities.description: Increases or decreases accuracy by the value specified in the parameter.

abilities.name: AddCP
abilities.description: Unknown (although one would assume this can be used to add/remove CP)

abilities.name: AffectExit
abilities.description: Unknown

abilities.name: AffectsAnimals
abilities.description: Used in spells to make it ONLY affect animals.

abilities.name: AffectsLiving
abilities.description: Used in spells to limit their abilities to only living players or monsters. See "NonLiving"

abilities.name: AffectsUndead
abilities.description: Used to make a spell ONLY work on undead monsters.

abilities.name: Agility
abilities.description: Increases or decreases the Agility stat by the value specified in the parameter.

abilities.name: Alter HP
abilities.description: increases or decreases the targets max HP

abilities.name: Alter thirst
abilities.description: Unknown

abilities.name: AlterDRpercent
abilities.description: changes DR by the % in the value (is cast by some Mod 9 monsters with negative values.)

abilities.name: AlterGeneralLightDuration
abilities.description: Unknown

abilities.name: Alterhunger
abilities.description: Unknown

abilities.name: AlterSpDmg
abilities.description: Unknown (alter spells damage (eg: used in an item or another spell to temporarily increase all spells damage)?)

abilities.name: AlterSpLength
abilities.description: Unknown (alter the length of duration spells (eg: used in an item or another spell to temporarily increase all future spells durations)?)

abilities.name: Animal
abilities.description: Used in monster attributes to flag a monster as an animal. See "Affects Animals".

abilities.name: AntiMagic
abilities.description: Used in the Witchunter class definition, apperently the only effect being that MR effects beneficial as well as combat spells cast on the target.

abilities.name: BadAttk
abilities.description: Do not Attack if Item Nmbr

abilities.name: Bash
abilities.description: Used in almost all class definition to grant the ability to bash attack monsters.

abilities.name: BlindingLight
abilities.description: Unknown

abilities.name: BlindUser
abilities.description: Blinds the target.

abilities.name: BloodChampQuest
abilities.description: This is the progress the player has made with the Blood Champion quest.

abilities.name: BSAccu
abilities.description: Used in items (although I can see no reason why it couldn't be used in a spell) to specify the backstab accuracy for the weapon. A positive value increases the chance to hit, a negative value decreases the chance to hit.

abilities.name: BsMaxDmg
abilities.description: Used in items (although I can see no reason why it couldn't be used in a spell) to specify a higher (or lower) maximum backstab damage for the weapon when armed.

abilities.name: BsMinDmg
abilities.description: Used in items (although I can see no reason why it couldn't be used in a spell) to specify a higher (or lower) minimum backstab damage for the weapon when armed.

abilities.name: CannotWearLocation
abilities.description: Unknown (perhaps used to make an item that can be worn on multiple locations, but, this flag is used to define WHICH locations it cannot be used on?)

abilities.name: CastOnEnd%
abilities.description: cast a spell specificed in the next EndCast ability when this spell ends only Value % chance of the time

abilities.name: CastsSp
abilities.description: Casts the spell when an item is 'used', or, with the %Spell attribute, this is the spell that is cast when the % chance is met.

abilities.name: Charm
abilities.description: Increases or decreases the Charm stat by the value specified in the parameter.

abilities.name: ClassOk
abilities.description: Used in items to make the item equippable by classes they aren't intended to be used with.

abilities.name: ClassStealth
abilities.description: Used in Class definitions to grant class stealth.

abilities.name: ClearItem
abilities.description: Poofs or unequips item number?

abilities.name: ConfuseMsg
abilities.description: Sets the confusion message for a previous "Confusion" attribute. The parameter specifies the message number to use for when the player is confused and fumbles. For the Mage spell "confusion", the message is along the lines of "You fumble in confusion!".

abilities.name: Confusion
abilities.description: Confuses the target, making them fumble in the % specified by the parameter. A parameter of +50 would make them fumble 50% of the time-- most "stun" spells use this with a value of +100, which makes the target fumble 100% of the time.

abilities.name: Crits
abilities.description: Increases or decreases the targets critical hit chance by the value specified in the parameter.

abilities.name: Cure Poison
abilities.description: Cures poison (cure poison has a parameter of 8, as does antidote).

abilities.name: Cursed
abilities.description: Used on items, once worn, a Cursed item can't be removed.

abilities.name: CURSED
abilities.description: has the same affects as 82 (curse) so you can't remove an item but it also makes it not drop at death (unlike 82).. although the item is still unequipped at death so it kinda doesn't work right.

abilities.name: Damage
abilities.description: Does damage in the amount specified by the parameter. MR is not taken into account.

abilities.name: Damage(-MR)
abilities.description: Does damage which takes into account the targets MR (or so the name implies).

abilities.name: DamageShield
abilities.description: Used to setup a shockshield for the player. Shockshield uses this.

abilities.name: DaoLordQuest
abilities.description: This is the progress the player has made with the DaoLord quest.

abilities.name: DarkDruidQuest
abilities.description: This is the progress the player has made with the Dark Druid quest.

abilities.name: DeathText
abilities.description: Unknown (executes the specified text block when the player dies?)

abilities.name: DefenseModifier
abilities.description: Unknown

abilities.name: Del@Maint
abilities.description: Used in items to delete the item, hidden or not, at cleanup.

abilities.name: DescMsg
abilities.description: Used in spells. Specifies the message in WCCMSG.DAT to use when the spell wears off, when you are looked at, and when you type 'STAT' to see the effect listed.

abilities.name: DetectMagic
abilities.description: Detects the magic in an item.

abilities.name: DisarmTraps
abilities.description: In Race and Class definitions, this grants the ability to disarm traps, in items, this can be used to enhance the ability.

abilities.name: DispellMagic
abilities.description: cancels spells that affect the ability in the value (ie dispellmagic +107 cancels spells giving the "blind" ability), but probably only certain ones

abilities.name: Dodge
abilities.description: Increases or decreases the targets ability to Dodge by the % value specified in the parameter.

abilities.name: DR
abilities.description: Modifies the DR value specified by the parameter. Note that DR is expressed in multiples of 10.

abilities.name: Drain
abilities.description: Drains HP from the target to the caster. (usually seen in spells)

abilities.name: empty
abilities.description: The "nothing" attribute. New objects automatically have their attributes filled with this.

abilities.name: Encum
abilities.description: Increases or decreases the targets encumberance % by the value specified in the parameter.

abilities.name: EndCast
abilities.description: Used in spell definitions to chain to another spell at the end of the current ones cast. EndCast is only called if the first spell doesn't fail.

abilities.name: EnergyLevel
abilities.description: Modifies the Energy level specified by the parameter.

abilities.name: Enslave
abilities.description: Charms the target.

abilities.name: EquipItem
abilities.description: Unknown (equip either the specific item, or, perhaps the value is an item location? (head, arms, etc)? and the first elgible item found in the players inventory is used?)

abilities.name: Evil
abilities.description: In spells and items, makes the spell/item useable only by Evil aligned characters.

abilities.name: EvilChance
abilities.description: Unknown

abilities.name: EvilInCombat
abilities.description: Used in spells to generate evil warnings and give EP when used.

abilities.name: EvilQuest
abilities.description: This is the progress the player has made with the EVIL quest.

abilities.name: Experience
abilities.description: Unknown (although one would assume this can be used to add/remove experience)

abilities.name: Fear
abilities.description: Makes the target flee in fear. Used in duration spells.

abilities.name: FindTraps
abilities.description: In Race and Class definitions, this grants the ability to find traps, in items, this can be used to enhance the ability.

abilities.name: FindTrapsValue
abilities.description: alters user's Traps Value

abilities.name: Freedom
abilities.description: Frees the target from holding spells and spells that alter the targets speed.

abilities.name: GHouseDeed
abilities.description: Gang House Deed value

abilities.name: GHouseItem
abilities.description: Gang House Item

abilities.name: GHouseTax
abilities.description: Gang House Tax value

abilities.name: GiveTempSpell
abilities.description: Unknown (gives the spell specified in Value/Parameter temporarily, as in, it appears in the spells/powers list? Maybe used in future items to give out spells only if a player has a specific item or has a specific item armed/equipped?)

abilities.name: Good
abilities.description: In spells and items, makes the spell/item useable only by Good aligned characters.

abilities.name: GoodQuest
abilities.description: This is the progress the player has made with the GOOD quest.

abilities.name: GShopItem
abilities.description: Gang Shop Item (controller)

abilities.name: Heal
abilities.description: Heals damage specified by the value in the parameter.

abilities.name: HealMana
abilities.description: Regenerates mana back by the value specified in the parameter.

abilities.name: Health
abilities.description: Increases or decreases the Health stat by the value specified in the parameter.

abilities.name: HitMagic
abilities.description: CLASS/PLAYER bypass ability for hitting magical creatures. get_user_ability_value(0x8e, player) in attack_user_monster sums the player's class HitMagic(142) plus any equipped items with HitMagic(142). This total is subtracted from the monster's Magical(28) requirement BEFORE the weapon is checked. If class+item HitMagic >= monster requirement, the weapon needs no Magical(28) at all. NOTE: Items with HitMagic(142) only (no Magical(28)) are NOT blocked by the Witchunter AntiMagic check — making them the only way for Witchunters to bypass magical creature gates beyond their class bonus.

abilities.name: HoldPerson
abilities.description: Holds the target in the room. Used with duration spells. Entangle and Hold Person use this attribute.

abilities.name: HPRegen
abilities.description: Used in any object to modify the targets HP regen rate. The Druid spell "Rapid Healing" and the module-1 quest rings use this attribute.

abilities.name: IceSorcQuest
abilities.description: This is the progress the player has made with the Ice Sorceress quest.

abilities.name: Illu
abilities.description: Increases or decreases the light value for the target ONLY by the value specified in the parameter.

abilities.name: IlluTarget
abilities.description: Increases or decreases the light level for the target specified by the value in the parameter.

abilities.name: ImmuPoison
abilities.description: Used in duration spells to make the target immune to poison.

abilities.name: Intel
abilities.description: Increases or decreases the Intel stat by the value specified in the parameter.

abilities.name: Invisibility
abilities.description: Unknown (some new form of stealth perhaps that doesn't rely on Stealth?)

abilities.name: JumpKACY
abilities.description: believed to alter jump accuracy value

abilities.name: JumpKDmg
abilities.description: Increases jumpkick damage for the Mystic jumpkick attack.

abilities.name: JumpKick
abilities.description: Used in the Mystic class definition to grant the JumpKick ability. A parameter of +1 is used in their definition.

abilities.name: KaiBind
abilities.description: Prevents the target from using Kai powers. Seen in 1.1u's race change to Half-Ogre's.

abilities.name: Kick
abilities.description: Used in the Mystic class definition to grant the Kick ability. A parameter of +1 is used in their definition.

abilities.name: KickACY
abilities.description: believed to alter kick accuracy value

abilities.name: KickDmg
abilities.description: Increases kick damage for the Mystic kick attack.

abilities.name: Killblow
abilities.description: Unknown

abilities.name: KillSpell
abilities.description: Kills a spell without calling it's EndCast effect (if one exists).

abilities.name: LearnSp
abilities.description:
Places the spell specified in the parameter into the players spells list. Also used for Kai powers and Bard songs. Use this in a
scroll item. The parameter is the spell number.

abilities.name: Lore
abilities.description: Unknown

abilities.name: LoyalItem
abilities.description: Makes the item stay with the player even into death. Seen in items.

abilities.name: M.R.
abilities.description: Increases or decreases the targets MR by the value specified in the parameter.

abilities.name: MageBaneQuest
abilities.description: This Determines if the player has completed the MageBane quest.

abilities.name: MageBind
abilities.description: did use to make spellcasting impossible but not sure it's still working.

abilities.name: Magical
abilities.description: Defines the magical potency of an item. Witchunters cannot use items with this flag. To make a non-magical item hit highly magical creatures, use the HitMagic flag.

abilities.name: ManaRgn
abilities.description: Used in objects to increase or decrease the targets mana regen by the percent specified in the parameter. A value of +25 would increase the targets mana regen by 25%. A value of +100 would increase the targets mana regen by 100% (double).

abilities.name: Max Damage
abilities.description: Modifies max damage to the value specified by the parameter.

abilities.name: MaxLevel
abilities.description: Typically seen in items to restrict them to players ONLY of the level specified or LOWER. The value in the parameter is the maximum level.

abilities.name: MaxMana
abilities.description: Increases or decreases the targets maximum mana by the value specified in the parameter.

abilities.name: Meditate
abilities.description: Meditate skill granted

abilities.name: MinLevel
abilities.description: Typically seen in items (useless for spells since they have their own internal Minimum level field) to restrict them to players ONLY of the level specified or higher. The value in the parameter is the minimum level.

abilities.name: MonsGuards
abilities.description: Used in monster definitions to define a monster that protects this one. The parameter points to an entry in the monster database that will protect this one. Multiple MonsGuards can be used to make the monster be protected by different monsters.

abilities.name: Mute
abilities.description: Strikes the target mute, making them unable to talk in rooms, etc.

abilities.name: NegateAbility
abilities.description: Removes the ability number?

abilities.name: Neutral
abilities.description: In spells and items, makes the spell/item useable only by Neutral aligned characters.

abilities.name: NeutralQuest
abilities.description: This is the progress the player has made with the NEUTRAL quest.

abilities.name: NonLiving
abilities.description: Used in monster attributes to flag the monster as being Non Living which makes it impossible to cast spells flagged as AffectsLiving on them. See "AffectsLiving"

abilities.name: NonMagicalSpell
abilities.description: Flags the spell as non-magical, thus making it immune to MR.

abilities.name: NotEvil
abilities.description: Used in items/spells to flag the object as being useable by any alignment EXCEPT Evil. (Lawful, Saint, Good, Neutral and Seedy can use it, but Outlaw, Criminal, Villain and FIEND cannot.)

abilities.name: NotGood
abilities.description: Used in items/spells to flag the object as being useable by any alignment EXCEPT Good. (Neutral, Seedy, Outlaw, Criminal, Villain and FIEND can use it, but Good, Saint, Lawful cannot.)

abilities.name: NotNeutral
abilities.description: Used in items/spells to flag the object as being useable by any alignment EXCEPT Neutral. (Lawful, Saint, Good, Outlaw, Criminal, Villain and FIEND can use it, but Neutral and Seedy cannot.)

abilities.name: OpenDoor
abilities.description: Unknown (opens a door, I assume, but how it determines direction/etc is unknown)

abilities.name: Paralyze
abilities.description: Unknown

abilities.name: Percep
abilities.description: Increases or decreases the targets perception by the value specified in the parameter.

abilities.name: PerStealth
abilities.description: Perfect Stealth

abilities.name: PhoenixQuest
abilities.description: This is the progress the player has made with the Phoenix feather quest.

abilities.name: Picklocks
abilities.description: In Race and Class definitions, this grants the ability to Picklock, in items, this can be used to enhance the ability.

abilities.name: PickLocksValue
abilities.description: alters user's PickLocks Value

abilities.name: Poison
abilities.description: Poisons the target doing damage specified by the value in the parameter.

abilities.name: ProtEvil
abilities.description: Protection from evil.

abilities.name: ProtGood
abilities.description: Protection from good.

abilities.name: Punch
abilities.description: Used in the Mystic class definition to grant the Punch ability. A parameter of +1 is used in their definition.

abilities.name: PunchACY
abilities.description: believed to alter punch accuracy value

abilities.name: PunchDmg
abilities.description: Increases punch damage for the Mystic punch attack.

abilities.name: Quality
abilities.description: Specifies an items "Quality". The only effect of this is to counter "Shatter". See "Shatter".

abilities.name: QuestItem
abilities.description: Makes the item a quest item

abilities.name: Quickness
abilities.description: does in fact make you walk faster (but only to a point so that it only matters if you're heavy.)

abilities.name: RaceStealth
abilities.description: Used in Race definitions to grant racial stealth.

abilities.name: Rcol
abilities.description: Modifies resistance to cold by the value specified by the parameter.

abilities.name: Rcrs
abilities.description: Remove curse. Seen in spells. The Priest spell "Remove Curse" uses this flag. Removes all cursed items.

abilities.name: Recharge
abilities.description: Used in items to specify the amount of "uses" to recharge at cleanup.

abilities.name: RechargeItem
abilities.description: Unknown

abilities.name: Remove@Maint
abilities.description: Used in items-- removes the item at cleanup, poofing it.

abilities.name: RemovesSpell
abilities.description: Used in spells to remove other spells (cancel them out).

abilities.name: ReqToHit
abilities.description: Monsters with this flag require that weapons (and spells?) with this IDENTICAL flag (including parameter) be used to attack it. NOTHING else will work on these monsters.

abilities.name: ResistStone
abilities.description: Modifies resistance to stone by the value specified by the parameter.

abilities.name: ResistWater
abilities.description: Increases or decreases the targets resistance to Water by the value specified in the parameter.

abilities.name: Rfir
abilities.description: Modifies resistance to fire by the value specified by the parameter.

abilities.name: Rlit
abilities.description: Modifies resistance to lightning by the value specified by the parameter.

abilities.name: RoomIllu
abilities.description: Increases or decreases the light value for the entire room by the value specified in the parameter.

abilities.name: RoomVisible
abilities.description: Makes the item visible to the entire room.

abilities.name: Rune
abilities.description: Flags the object as a Rune. Seen in one item.

abilities.name: S.C.
abilities.description: Incresaes or decreases the targets SC by the value specified in the parameter.

abilities.name: ScatterItems
abilities.description: Scatters the items in the room to the specified room(s). You can use a range to specify multiple rooms, but, these rooms must all be a part of the current map.

abilities.name: Scry
abilities.description: Unknown (perhaps show the room specificed in the value? No idea really)

abilities.name: SeeHidden
abilities.description: Grants the ability to see hidden players. For monsters, this allows them to see hidden players and attack them while they are sneaking or hiding. The monster will also follow even if the player escapes and re-sneaks.

abilities.name: SeeInvisible
abilities.description: Unknown (most likely a way for monsters/players to see others with this new Invisible ability)

abilities.name: Shadow
abilities.description: Displays "A shadowy figure!" when looked at by other players.

abilities.name: Shadowform
abilities.description: This functions much like shadowform except the value states which text block to display when the player is looked at.

abilities.name: Shatter
abilities.description: Shatters the targets weapon. The parameter (in theory) specifies which "Quality" of weapons the spell affects and can shatter. The Druid sell "Shatter" specifies a parameter of 1, and thus will not work on items with a Quality of or greater than 1.

abilities.name: SheDragonQuest
abilities.description: This is the progress the player has made with the SheDragon quest.

abilities.name: Shock
abilities.description: Sets the Shockshield message for the spell/item. See "DmgShield".

abilities.name: Slay
abilities.description: Unknown. Used by the "laen longsword" item.

abilities.name: Sleep
abilities.description: Unknown

abilities.name: Slowness
abilities.description: Modifies the room movement time while not affecting stealth as a modified encumbrance would. The Mage spell "Slow" uses a parameter of +200 for this attribute.

abilities.name: Smash
abilities.description: Unknown

abilities.name: Speed
abilities.description: Increases or decreases the targets swing speed with their weapon or attack by the value specified in the parameter. The Mage spell "Speed" uses +85 for a parameter, the Mage spell "Slow" uses +125.

abilities.name: SpellColours
abilities.description: Unknown (perhaps a way to specific the ANSI colour coding for spells, overriding the default colours for the spell?)

abilities.name: SpellComponent
abilities.description: Make the item a spell component.

abilities.name: SpellImmu
abilities.description: Used in objects to make the target immune to spells below or equal to the level specified in the parameter.

abilities.name: StartMsg
abilities.description: Used in spells to specify the 'start message' for the spell.Basically, this sets the opening line for the spell before the Cast Message is sent.

abilities.name: StealHPtoMP
abilities.description: Unknown (convert stolen HP to Mana instead? Works like the other 'Steal' abilities?)

abilities.name: StealMana
abilities.description: Unknown (most likely steals Mana from another Player or monster for the value specified (or min/max in a spell))

abilities.name: StealMPtoHP
abilities.description: Unknown (convert stolen Mana to HP instead? Works like the other 'Steal' abilities?)

abilities.name: Stealth
abilities.description: Modifies stealth by the value in the parameter.

abilities.name: Strength
abilities.description: Increases or decreases the Strength stat by the value specified in the parameter.

abilities.name: Summon
abilities.description: Summons a monster specified by the parameter. The value in parameter is the monster number.

abilities.name: TeleportMap
abilities.description: Teleports the target to the specified map in the parameter. Usually seen with a "Teleport room". See "Teleport room".

abilities.name: TeleportRoom
abilities.description: Teleports the target to the specified room in the parameter. Usually seen with a "Teleport map". See "Teleport map".

abilities.name: TextBlock
abilities.description: Executes the text block specified by the parameter.

abilities.name: Thievery
abilities.description: In Race and Class definitions, this grants the ability to Rob, in items, this can be used to enhance the ability.

abilities.name: Tracking
abilities.description: Used in Race and Class definitions to grant Tracking to a Race/Class.

abilities.name: UnEquipItem
abilities.description: Unknown (remove either the specific item, or, perhaps the value is an item location? (head, arms, etc)?)

abilities.name: Visible@Maint
abilities.description: Used in items to keep them visible at cleanup.

abilities.name: WereratQuest
abilities.description: This is the progress the player has made with the Wererat quest.

abilities.name: Wisdom
abilities.description: Increases or decreases the Wisdom/Willpower stat by the value specified in the parameter.
